name: AUSX 360
summary:
Get closer to the action than ever before with the official AUSX Supercross streaming service.

Watch Australia's premier Supercross championship live and on demand, featuring the nation's fastest riders battling it out across spectacular stadium and arena events. From gate drops and qualifying sessions to main events, podium celebrations, and exclusive behind-the-scenes content, this is your ultimate destination for AUSX Supercross.
